annotations.title: utilpeek: daily GPU rental price history by chip: lowest and median list price, spot, Akash marketplace bid and free GPUs

description: utilpeek: GPU price index: daily H100, H200, A100 rental price per GPU-hour over time. Returns a GPU chip's daily rental price history: lowest and median on-demand list price, lowest spot, Akash median bid and free GPUs. List prices and marketplace bids, not executed trades. Days without a snapshot are missing, not interpolated. Typically under 0.1 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/cloud-gpu-price-api.html

chip.description: GPU chip, any case, e.g. H100, H200 or A100 80GB.
chip.title: Chip

from.description: First UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 29 days before `to`).
from.title: From

to.description: Last UTC day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: the newest day recorded).
to.title: To

name: get_gpu_price_index

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
